title: MDF Capability Document
description: Schema for the /mdf.json capability document served by MDF-compliant sites. Advertises markdown serving capabilities, per-rail pricing, content signals and, where a section issues a credential rather than per-fetch content, the auth endpoint. There is no payment-object requirement: an x402 v2 client pays by retrying the resource URL with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, so a site priced entirely per fetch needs no payment or auth block at all. The only structural requirement left is that a token-access section must name somewhere to obtain the token.
$comment: Root conditional, expressed as the contrapositive so it can be evaluated over an object-valued sections map: if auth.endpoint is absent, then no price entry (default or any section) may carry access: token. Equivalently, any token-access entry requires auth.endpoint.

mdf_version.description: The MDF spec version this document conforms to, as MAJOR.MINOR or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. 0.3.0 is published as a three-component version, so the pattern accepts both forms; documents SHOULD use the full form the spec is released under.

site.description: Canonical base URL of the site. Must use https://.

name.description: Human-readable name of the site or publisher.

pricing.description: Pricing configuration. Defines the default price and optional per-section overrides. Price is the primary access policy signal. Each price is expressed as a list of rails, one entry per rail the site will accept for that path, each with its own price in that rail's own units. There is no exchange-rate conversion anywhere in this specification: every rail's price is set by the publisher.

default.description: Default price applied to all paths not matched by a section override.

sections.description: Path-pattern-keyed price overrides. Keys are glob patterns matched against the request path. More specific patterns take precedence. Patterns follow standard glob rules: * matches within a path segment, ** matches across segments.

propertyNames.description: Glob pattern for path matching, e.g. /docs/**, /premium/*

auth.description: Credential issuance. Present when at least one price entry carries access: token, and required in that case (enforced by the root conditional). The endpoint is where an agent presents payment and receives a bearer token instead of per-fetch content, and it is the same location a 402 advertises as extensions.mdf.info.auth_endpoint. Payment.endpoint from 0.2.x folded in here: x402 v2 clients pay the resource URL itself, so a separate payment host only ever existed for the token flow.

endpoint.description: URL to which agents submit payment proof to receive a bearer token. Required when any price entry has access: token.

token_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of issued bearer tokens in seconds.

content_signals.description: Advisory signals indicating how agents and operators may use content served from this site. These are signals, not technical enforcement mechanisms.

ai_train.description: Whether content may be used for AI model training.

ai_input.description: Whether content may be used as context input during AI inference.

search.description: Whether content may be indexed by search systems.

human_only.description: If true, the site requests that agents do not fetch content regardless of price. MDF serving may still be technically available but is explicitly discouraged.

formats.description: Markdown format capabilities advertised by this site.

dialect.description: The markdown dialect produced by this site's MDF endpoint.

frontmatter.description: Whether markdown responses include YAML frontmatter with page metadata.

math.description: Whether the site uses LaTeX math notation in markdown content.

feed.description: Content freshness and agent subscription configuration. MDF extends standard RSS/Atom feeds with change-type metadata and optionally supports WebSub push notifications.

url.description: URL of the site's RSS 2.0 or Atom 1.0 feed, extended with MDF change metadata.

websub_hub.description: WebSub hub URL for push notifications. Agents that support WebSub can subscribe here to receive change notifications without polling. Falls back to feed polling if absent.

change_types.description: List of mdf:change_type values this feed emits. Agents can use this to filter subscription interest.

llms_txt.description: URL of the site's llms.txt index file, if present. MDF-compliant sites should also maintain an llms.txt for backwards compatibility with agents that do not yet support MDF.

contact.description: Contact address for MDF-related enquiries. May be an email address or URL.

price_not_token.description: Matches any price entry that is not token-access. Used by the root conditional as the contrapositive of 'a token-access entry requires auth.endpoint': with no auth endpoint, no entry may be access: token. Also matches a free or per-fetch entry, and an entry with access omitted (the default, per_fetch).

price_entry.description: The rails a request under this path pattern may be paid on, and how access is granted. One rail entry per configured rail; an empty list means open access. Each rail prices itself: there is no canonical price and no exchange rate, so two rails at the same path are two independent publisher-set prices, not one price converted.

rails.description: The rails offered for this path. The 402's accepts[] entries for a resource MUST correspond one-to-one to these, minus any rail that is currently degraded or unavailable.

access.description: How payment on this path is turned into access. 'per_fetch' (the default) delivers the resource on payment and is the x402 path: the client retries the resource URL with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. 'token' means payment issues a bearer token for the path instead, presented on later fetches, as named by auth.endpoint. It is a publisher decision per section, not a price threshold: with per-rail prices in different units and no exchange rate, a price comparison cannot decide it. A token entry MUST have at least one rail — a free token tier is meaningless.

price_rail.description: One rail's price for one path pattern, expressed in that rail's own units.

scheme.description: x402 payment scheme for this rail, e.g. 'exact'. Named per rail because 'exact' is not the only scheme x402 defines.

network.description: Settlement network, as a CAIP-2 identifier. MDF 0.3.0 uses eip155:8453, eip155:84532, and the lnbtc: networks defined by the upstream lnbtc scheme.

asset.description: The asset paid on this rail, as the rail identifies it: a token contract address on an eip155 network, or the scheme's asset identifier ('BTC' for lnbtc). Not a currency symbol chosen for display.

amount.description: This rail's price, in that rail's own atomic units — micro-USDC for a 6-decimal stablecoin, millisatoshis for Lightning — as an integer decimal string with no sign, decimal point, exponent, separator or unit suffix. Same convention as accepts[].amount in the 402. A rail is never priced at zero: an unpriced path is an empty rail list.
